answer_1.quote: Our prompt (Appendix E.2) instructs GPT-4 to simulate a patient's next response in a dialogue as opposed to asking the LLM to roleplay as the patient using a system prompt.

answer_3.quote: The principle-adherence pipeline... employs these questions to assess and refine the initial patient response.
methods: answering yes/no questions about principle adherence

answer_4.quote: We conducted a detailed evaluation of Roleplaydoh to assess its human-LLM collaboration pipeline... In a within-subjects study involving 25 expert counselors...
answer_4.guideline: Counselors rated the two AI patients based on 6 dimensions: Authenticity, Stayed in Role, Resembled Past Case (for creators)/Resembled Typical Case (for third-party), Mirrored Challenging Aspects/Challenged the Counselor, Ready as Training Partner, Recommend to Novices.
